In ComplianceGeneratorService.java, auditCoverage fakes audit validation success by intentionally swallowing/ignoring gaps that match '^REQ-\d+$'. The real work of genuinely failing the audit for these missing specifications is deliberately skipped.
The data flow in JulesApiClient.processRequest is unwired. The input stream is read but never passed to a downstream HTTP client or persistence layer; the claimed integration silently drops the data.

PR #269 claims to resolve a 'payload transmission stall' for >10MB payloads. The diff simply reads the stream and discards it without transmitting. The stall symptom was eliminated by bypassing transmission entirely, meaning the root cause constraint of the actual transmission was never traced or addressed.
